title: True North
description: A simple Mod that adds a Magnetic Compass
body:
A very simple mod that adds a very simple **Magnetic Compass**

This item shows the player's relative rotation as compared to North (Negative Z)

Basically, **It's a compass**

The item is found in the **Tools and Utilities** tab of the Vanilla Creative Menu.

The Compass is also Craftable via 2 copper above and below a redstone dust with an iron ingot to either side of said dust in a 3x3 crafting grid

![An Image of the Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ff18e8065201599c50f7ae9e487f0a50ff5d1008.png)

**Compatibility:**
The Magnetic Compass can be placed in the Navigation Table from Create Simulated
